PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

2. When learning Introduction to Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.

3. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.

4. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.

5. When learning Free-hand sketching, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Free-hand sketching.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Free-hand sketching.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Free-hand sketching.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Free-hand sketching.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Non- Metallic Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Non- Metallic Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

9. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

11. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Production Unit 10 5.3 Financial Goals 10 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Production Unit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Goals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
